# JSB Infraproducts Pvt. Ltd.

> JSB Infraproducts supplies aggregates, ready mix concrete, cement, fly ash, admixtures, micro silica, AAC blocks and slab ice to builders, contractors and RMC plants across Mumbai and the MMR.

- Quote turnaround: within 24 hours

## Products

- [Aggregates](https://www.jsbinfra.com/products/aggregates): Graded crushed stone and manufactured sand, screened to size and supplied in bulk to RMC plants, high-rise sites and infrastructure projects across Mumbai and the MMR. Supplied: 10 mm aggregate, 20 mm aggregate, 40 mm aggregate, Crushed sand (M-sand), Plaster sand, Grit.
- [Ready Mix Concrete](https://www.jsbinfra.com/products/ready-mix-concrete): Plant-batched ready mix concrete delivered in transit mixers, timed to your pour plan. We supply standard and high-strength grades for residential, commercial and infrastructure work. Supplied: M10 to M25 (general grades), M30 to M50 (structural grades), M60 and above (high strength), Pumpable mixes, Self-compacting concrete.
- [Cement (OPC & PPC)](https://www.jsbinfra.com/products/cement): Ordinary Portland Cement and Portland Pozzolana Cement from leading brands, supplied in bags or bulk tankers to sites and batching plants across the MMR. Supplied: OPC 43 grade, OPC 53 grade, PPC, 50 kg bags, Bulk tanker supply.
- [Fly Ash](https://www.jsbinfra.com/products/fly-ash): Class F fly ash used as a supplementary cementitious material. It partially replaces cement, improves workability and long-term strength, and lowers the carbon footprint of every cubic metre. Supplied: Class F (siliceous) fly ash, Bulk tanker supply.
- [Chemicals & Additives](https://www.jsbinfra.com/products/construction-chemicals): Concrete admixtures that control workability, water content and setting time, so high-performance mixes stay pumpable and on spec in Mumbai heat and monsoon conditions. Supplied: High-range water reducers, Superplasticizers (PCE based), Retarders, Accelerators, Waterproofing admixtures.
- [Micro Silica](https://www.jsbinfra.com/products/micro-silica): Densified micro silica (silica fume) for ultra-high-strength and low-permeability concrete, used in high-rise cores, marine structures and grades such as M70. Supplied: Densified micro silica, 25 kg bags, Bulk bags.
- [AAC Blocks](https://www.jsbinfra.com/products/aac-blocks): Autoclaved aerated concrete blocks that are lighter than clay bricks, faster to lay and better at insulation. They reduce dead load on high-rise frames and speed up masonry. Supplied: 100 mm blocks, 150 mm blocks, 200 mm blocks, Block-jointing mortar.
- [Slab Ice](https://www.jsbinfra.com/products/slab-ice): Slab ice supplied to RMC plants and sites to keep fresh concrete within specified placing temperatures, especially for mass pours and summer concreting. Supplied: Slab ice blocks, Scheduled daily supply.

## FAQ

### What construction materials does JSB Infraproducts supply?
Aggregates, ready mix concrete, OPC and PPC cement, fly ash, concrete admixtures, micro silica, AAC blocks and slab ice. One supplier covers the full material list for a typical concrete project.

### Which areas do you deliver to?
Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Raigad and the wider Mumbai Metropolitan Region. Main plants are in Goregaon, Mira Road and Mankoli, with tie-up plants in Bhayander, Kandivali, Powai, Thane and Wadala.

### How quickly will I get a quote?
Our team responds within 24 hours. Include the material, grade, quantity, site location and target dates for the fastest quote. For urgent needs, call or WhatsApp +91 93269 89258.

### Who does JSB supply to?
Real estate developers, civil contractors, infrastructure projects and RMC plants. Clients include Hubtown, Hiranandani, DGS Group, AH Construction, Unwal, H. Rishabraj and AMI, along with other infrastructure contractors. Channel partners and tie-ups include UltraTech, JSW, Prism RMC, Procon RMC and RDC.

### Is material tested before dispatch?
Yes. Every batch is lab-tested against the relevant Indian Standard before it leaves the plant.

### Can you deliver during the monsoon or at night?
Yes. Our owned fleet runs around the clock with slot-based scheduling, so deliveries can be aligned with night pours and monsoon windows.
